content:
alex: Quick sync — we're targeting a default-model flip on /v1/generate next month. I want to confirm the deprecation timeline and exactly what the server shim does for older SDKs. Proposal below. feedback?

maria: +1 on a clear timeline. Can we do 30 days notice, then a 2-week canary, then flip?

sam: 30d notice sounds fine. What does the shim do if no Accept-Model header provided? Return old default or 406?

alex: Plan is: 1) notice + docs + SDK warnings, 2) server shim that treats missing Accept-Model as "legacy-default" for 30d (zero-downtime), 3) after canary, flip default for new traffic but keep a fallback path: if client sends `X-Client-Supports-Default=0` we keep legacy default for that request.

jen: Can we avoid a new header? Lots of customers won't update their clients. Maybe SDKs add a structured header automatically (like `Accept-Model: redwood/v2`) so server doesn't need custom flags.

paul: Agree w/jen. If SDKs add `Accept-Model`, server can respond with `Deprecation-Warning` header for a while. Also, need to ensure embeddings endpoints unaffected.

sam: Implementation detail: if we do automatic `Accept-Model` in SDKs, we should include a minor-version token so we can route by exact model variant, e.g. `Accept-Model: redwood/gpt-small;v=2026-03`

alex: Good call. I like using `Accept-Model` + `Deprecation-Warning`. For older clients with no header we do the shim for the notice window only. After cutoff we return 426 Upgrade Required with a helpful JSON body and link to migration docs.

maria: 426 makes sense post-cutoff but we should provide a gradual UX: deprecation header -> rate-limited warning in responses -> 426. Docs MUST include a sample patch:

```http
GET /v1/generate
Accept-Model: redwood/gpt-medium;v=2026-03
Authorization: Bearer <key>
```

and example response: `200` with `Deprecation-Warning: default-model will flip on 2026-04-30; include Accept-Model to opt-in`

ci-bot: canary-deploy: success — rollout/accept-model-shim to canary cluster at commit abc123 (:tada:)

paul: QA checklist: - ensure clients with older SDKs still get same payload shape - ensure telemetry flags when shim applied - ensure console shows per-route deprecation alerts

jen: Docs + changelog + SDK PRs needed. Devex to push a migration snippet and add to quickstart. Also check rate-limit behavior for repeated 426s.

alex: Action items: 1) I'll draft the deprecation notice + dates (30d notice -> 14d canary -> flip + 7d grace) 2) Sam/Paul implement shim + telemetry 3) Devex (Jen) to update SDKs and quickstart 4) Maria to own communication to customers. I'll open an RFC doc and tag eng, sdk, docs.

maria: thx — please @channel the RFC when it's ready.

alex: Will do. If no objections I'll file the RFC now and CC infra for rollout windows.

sam: No objections from me. I'll start a PR for the shim branch.

jen: I'll queue SDK PR and add Deprecation-Warning header support.

alex: Great — filing RFC now, pinging infra and support. Follow-ups in that doc. :white_check_mark:
